title: B24102860287

risks: paper claims tree-error-weighted forest, visible appendix uses standard RandomForestRegressor
feature importance is predictive, not causal
dBm arithmetic must return to linear power
same-experiment rows must be grouped when splitting
one printed classifier applies Softmax before CrossEntropyLoss

verified_text_evidence.claim: paper describes per-tree error weighted random forest
visible appendix uses standard sklearn RandomForestRegressor(n_estimators=200) and built-in feature_importances_
StandardScaler fitted before separating held-out tail rows
another appendix path fits scaler before train_test_split
visible classifier applies softmax then CrossEntropyLoss
paper reports >95% regression accuracy while average error about 5%

transfer_lessons: Use group-aware validation when multiple rows originate from one experiment/session/device.
Convert dBm to mW/W before summing desired/interference/noise powers.
Check whether an intermediate physical rate uniquely identifies the requested discrete label.
For regression use MAE/RMSE/R2 plus error quantiles/ECDF and threshold coverage instead of undefined accuracy.
Treat feature importance as predictive association unless causal identification is designed.
